settingsPhotos.title: Mirror photos
settingsPhotos.intro: A salon can only photograph you on its LUX mirror while this is on for that salon. Withdrawing stops future photos; delete existing ones separately.
settingsPhotos.noSalonsDescription: Shops that take mirror photos appear here after you book with them.
settingsPhotos.termsChanged: Photo terms changed — allow again to continue
settingsPhotos.deleteAtSalon: Delete my photos at this salon
settingsPhotos.myPhotosDescription: See the mirror photos shared with you
settingsPhotos.allowedFeedback: Mirror photos allowed at this salon.
settingsPhotos.withdrawnFeedback: Mirror photos withdrawn at this salon.
settingsPhotos.consentUpdateFailed: Could not update mirror photo consent

deleteDialog.title: Delete your photos at {{shop}}?
deleteDialog.body: Every mirror photo of you at this salon is removed from your photos and from the salon's record. This can't be undone. Your consent setting is not changed.

myPhotos.title: My photos
myPhotos.emptyBody: When a salon you've allowed captures your look on the mirror, it shows up here. You choose which salons may take photos under Settings › Mirror photos.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this photo?
deleteDialog.body: It is removed from your photos and from the salon's record of your visit. This can't be undone.

neverDialog.title: Never stream you?
neverDialog.body: Salons using LUX mirrors will not be able to stream any appointment you're in, and this request will be declined.

onAir.preparingBody: {{shop}} is about to start streaming to {{destinations}}.
onAir.stopHint: You can also ask your stylist to stop it.

inactive.title: This request is no longer active
inactive.body: It may have expired or been declined, or the stream has ended.

done.declined: You declined. {{shop}} won't stream this appointment.
done.never: Done. Salons won't be able to stream your appointments.

errors.respondFailed: Couldn't send your answer. Try again.
errors.stopFailed: Couldn't stop the stream. Ask your stylist to stop it.

settings.title: Live streams
settings.neverDescription: Salons using LUX mirrors will not be able to stream any appointment you're in.

training.title: Help improve LUX's hairstyle AI
training.on: On — salons that take part may take training frames of you.
training.off: Off (default) — no training frames are taken of you.
training.termsChanged: The wording changed — switch on again to keep helping.
training.summary: Lets LUX train its own hair and face model on still frames from the mirror. Here is exactly what you agree to:

training.onFeedback: Thanks — you can switch this off at any time.
training.offFeedback: Switched off. Frames already taken have left the training set.
